cards.card_text: Fast forward to the eighteenth year of his reign, when King Josiah sends Shaphan, his scribe, up to the house of the LORD to have Hilkiah the high priest count the money the doorkeepers collected from the people.
cards.verse_text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the scribe, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the house of the LORD, saying, “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count the money that has been brought into the house of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
cards.snippet: …that has been brought into the house of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.

cards.card_text: He gives orders to Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank and the doorkeepers.
cards.verse_text: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven.
cards.snippet: …commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made…

cards.card_text: The articles made for Baal and Asherah The money the doorkeepers collected The timber bought for the repairs

cards.verse_text: The captain of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.
cards.snippet: …the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.

cards.card_text: The singer says he'd rather dwell in the tents of the wicked than be a doorkeeper in the house of his God.
cards.verse_text: I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
cards.snippet: I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of…

cards.card_text: He brings them to the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God, near the officials' room, which sits above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
cards.verse_text: This room was near the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
cards.snippet: …officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.

cards.card_text: The captain of the guard takes people too: the top priests, the temple doorkeepers, the king's advisers and officials, and men still found in the city.
cards.verse_text: The captain of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.
cards.snippet: …the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.

cards.card_text: The man also tells the servant at the door, the doorkeeper, to keep ___.
cards.verse_text: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
cards.snippet: …put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.

cards.card_text: Then the other disciple talks to the doorkeeper and brings Peter in, like a coworker swiping you in when you forgot your badge.
cards.verse_text: Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
cards.snippet: …was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
